groupsScreen.offline: Offline: you're seeing the last saved copy. Changes need an internet connection.
groupsScreen.notConfigured: The server (Supabase) isn't set up. See supabase/README.md.
groupsScreen.allSettled: You're settled up in all your groups 🎉
groupsScreen.emptyText: Create a group for a trip, a shared flat or a dinner, or join someone else's with their invite code.

joinScreen.error: There's no group with that code, or you're offline.
joinScreen.intro: Ask someone in the group to send you the invite code. They'll find it in the group, under “Invite”.

newGroupScreen.failedMessage: You need an internet connection to create a group.

editGroup.mutedHint: You won't get notifications from this group. This only affects you.
editGroup.unmutedHint: We'll let you know when someone adds an expense or pays you. This only affects you.
editGroup.exportHint: The PDF sums up totals, balances, how to settle up and every transaction. The backup is a file you can keep (Drive, email…) and import again from “Import” on the main screen.
editGroup.archiveHint: Removes it from your list without deleting anything. This only affects you, and you can get it back from “Archived”.
editGroup.unarchiveHint: It will go back to your group list.
editGroup.deleteHint: Deletes it and all its expenses for every member. Only the person who created it can do this.
editGroup.leaveHint: It disappears from this phone; the others can still see it. Only the person who created it can delete it.

whoScreen.intro: Pick your name in “{{group}}”. That way the app knows which expenses are yours and how much you owe. It's only saved on this phone and you can change it any time.
whoScreen.nameTaken: That name's already taken. If it's you, pick it above.
